notes: Independently read all 26 production-source files and both package/manifest metadata files at the pinned commit. All 47 plugin files are partitioned into 28 reviewed and 19 excluded records. No Inspector implementation, detector output, other fixture, or generic expectation extractor was read or used.

All local static and dynamic imports/reexports stay inside extensions/minimax. api.ts and the OAuth/search barrels forward plugin-owned implementations, not SDK symbols. No additional shared shipped source lies outside this plugin root; SDK implementation files were consulted only to establish public export/type provenance, not recursively audited.

Public package.json export entries and SDK facades establish the exact imported subpaths/export names. Public aliases remain the names exported by each imported SDK module (for example provider-web-search#readStringParam). speech-provider-factory.ts aliases normalizeOptionalString locally as trimToUndefined; the original SDK export identity is retained.

PluginCapabilityCatalogHostContext explicitly types isProviderAuthProfileConfigured and isProviderAuthProfileConfiguredAsync as the provider-auth-availability helpers publicly reexported by provider-auth. Literal Pick selection adds type-reference; function-parameter destructuring adds member-access and direct invocation adds call. These exports have no synthetic import or module site.

api from definePluginEntry register is passed to registerMinimaxProviders, which explicitly annotates OpenClawPluginApi. Its api.runtime.config.current() is the sole concrete runtime access. Returned config data, provider/auth/catalog contexts, web-search contexts, speech provider objects, request/response objects and helper results are not API/runtime handles.
Provider replay/stream family hooks and provider hookAliases are provider contracts, not API on/registerHook registrations. No named hook finding is implied by SDK helper internals.

Immediate destructuring of dynamic SDK imports in speech-provider-factory.ts and tts.ts records the selected named exports with dynamic-import and actual call references, without synthetic namespace stars. Local lazy runtime imports load plugin-owned code, so they add no SDK-module site.

Parameters<typeof fetchWithTimeoutGuarded>, Parameters<typeof resolveApiKeyForProvider> and Parameters<typeof postJsonRequest> contribute type-reference to those SDK exports. Ordinary imports remain runtime; combined explicit type use/imports makes the export mixed while modules follow only dependency syntax.

stream.ts underlying directly selects streamSimple as its final nullish fallback; the direct invocation preserves that SDK call provenance. FAST_MODE_HOOKS is an SDK helper result, so its wrapStreamFn property is not expanded into an API/runtime member or a transitive helper call.

Source phase includes entry metadata, onboarding, policy/catalog modules, local barrels and eligible source regardless of runtime reachability. Package metadata declares index.ts and no alternative artifact/source exception. No installed dependency package was traversed.
